name: Wind Walk

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: you and up to ten willing creatures you can see

summary: You and up to ten willing creatures become clouds that fly fast over long distances.
text: In cloud form a creature has a Fly Speed of 300 ft, can hover, has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage and can only Dash or change back. Changing form takes a minute, during which it is Incapacitated.
